Greetings, Agents! 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
​

Through this Additional Patch, Carnage, 
who has become even more vicious and a fit for his name, will show new abilities!

 

A new Uniform and Tier-4 Advancement have been added for Carnage.

 

Check out the new skills and powers of Carnage
by downloading the 10/4 Patch!


■ 10/4 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 10/5 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 10/4 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 

 

[10/5 (Wed) 3:25 (UTC+0), 10/4 (Tue) 20:25 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 10/5 (Wed) 3:25 (UTC+0), 10/4 (Tue) 20:25 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 

▣ One New Uniform

 

Check out the abilities of Carnage’s <Fallen Soul> Uniform, 
who has a pure thirst for carnage!

* The new Uniform can be purchased after the 10/4 Patch data is applied 
and a 40% discount event will be applied to all Uniforms.
* The new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill level stats.
(Tier-4 hero: Lv. 10)  

 

 

▣ Carnage Tier-4

 

Carnage, an evil serial killer, has gained new powers 
with his tentacles that have become even stronger.
*The effects are based on Skill Level 6 stats. 

 

 

▣ New Artifact

 

A new Artifact has been added for Carnage.
* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill Level 4 stats.

 

 

▣ Gorr Improvements 

 

1. Some skill effects of Gorr <Marvel Studios’ Thor: Love and Thunder> have been improved.
*The effects are based on the maximum Skill Level. 

 

 

2. The portrait and design of Gorr <Marvel Studios’ Thor: Love and Thunder> have been changed.

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The issue of today's best score that has been achieved in Alliance Battle challenge mode 
    not being updated in certain cases has been fixed.

2. The issue of the pop-up screen informing that you do not possess enough Gold being displayed
    when attempting to enter Alliance Battle Normal Mode in certain cases has been fixed.
    - The issue has only occurred in certain cases.
    Gold has not been used when proceeding with Alliance Battle Normal Mode.

3. The Alliance Battle Legend Mode tips in certain languages 
    has been fixed to be shown entirely within the screen.

4. The projectile attack of the 4th skill of Agent Venom <Classic> has been fixed to continue smoothly.

5. Misspelled texts in the Artifact skill effects of Hulk in certain languages have been fixed.

6. The issue of other heroes not appearing in the skill VFX 
    of the Awakened Skill of Kaecilius, Baron Mordo, and Clea has been fixed.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated Super Villain.

 

Thank you.
